procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review in this session, without spawning, resuming, forking, peer reviews or producer/planner records. Read only the explicitly allowed pinned inputs; verified all listed SHA-256 values and byte counts. Read the five pinned production manifests before the first poster open without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares source_assets=[] and protected_layouts=[], so no source image opens or protected-layout reads were applicable. Actually opened and visually inspected each of the fifteen exact poster PNGs with tools.view_image(detail="original") through functions.exec, emitting each returned image for inspection. The actual initial order was M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2 in those three views, then M3, M4 and M5 likewise. All fifteen opens returned visible images. Deferred copy-reading/transcription, judgments and scores until after the M5 thumbnail completed. Transcribed the first readings from the retained visible pixels, preserving soft title wraps and meaningful word spaces; no OCR, inferred omitted copy, replacement asset, crop or revisit was used. Read-only PNG header checks matched packet dimensions and showed RGB opaque images; they are not being claimed as visual opens. All raw scores and the diversity value are independent judgments of the entire viewed set. No runtime thread/session ID is observable here; session_id is null.
